title: Urbz, The - Sims in the City (USA, Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl)

fields.name: magic_urbz0011
fields.evidence: FUN_0804d694 8-byte compare loop; FUN_0804da48 template memcpy (FUN_08033018, 0x18 bytes); bytes present in both .sav files.

fields.name: header_const_ff80
fields.evidence: Identical in both samples; inside FUN_0804d694/FUN_0804da48 24-byte header; semantics unknown.

fields.name: language_id
fields.evidence: Struct-relative offsets +0x0A in FUN_0804d74c/FUN_0804d6f0; 6 locales match title languages (En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl); exact index-to-language order beyond 0 is untested. Empirically verified via headless mGBA boundary fuzzing (crash/hang boundary: unsigned-range [0, 91]).

fields.name: header_flag_0x0b
fields.evidence: Writer body sets =1; diff between samples is 0->1 with checksum compensating by -0x100; PACKET probe mutation at this offset is rejected via header checksum, not via a counter check. Empirically verified via headless mGBA boundary fuzzing (save rejection boundary: unsigned-range [1, 255]).

fields.name: header_reserved_0x0c
fields.evidence: Inside 24-byte header in FUN_0804da48/FUN_0804d694.

fields.name: header_checksum
fields.evidence: Python recomputation matches stored values on both samples exactly; decompiled writer/validator bodies read in full.

fields.name: header_reserved_0x10
fields.evidence: Inside 24-byte header.

fields.name: header_sentinel_0x12
fields.evidence: Identical 0xFFFF in both samples inside the templated header.

fields.name: header_reserved_0x14
fields.evidence: Header length 0x18 used by FUN_0804d694/FUN_0804da48/FUN_0804d624.

fields.name: sector0_buffer_pointer_persisted
fields.evidence: Pointer value is an EWRAM address identical in both files; struct+0x18 dereferenced as buffer by FUN_0804d9e4/FUN_0804d938.

fields.name: sector0_reserved_0x1c_0xcb
fields.evidence: Zero in both samples; no decompiled function references struct offsets in this range.

fields.name: sector_valid_flags
fields.evidence: Exact struct offset +0xCC in two functions; file values change 00->01 per byte between captures in step with sector loading.

fields.name: stream_cursor_persisted
fields.evidence: Struct offsets +0xD4/+0xD8 in FUN_0804d938 and game FUN_0804d800; cap-01 value is an EWRAM pointer near the +0x18 buffer allocation.

fields.name: stream_state
fields.evidence: FUN_0804d800 game stream body; FUN_0804d938 stores 0 at struct+0xD8.

fields.name: sector0_payload_0x300_pointers
fields.evidence: Six EWRAM-pointer-shaped u32 values appear only in cap-01; likely references to live RAM objects, targets not identifiable from the save alone.

fields.name: sector0_flags_0x34a
fields.evidence: Five boolean-like bytes change 0->1 as a group; semantics unknown.

fields.name: sector0_payload_0x610_pointers
fields.evidence: Four EWRAM-pointer-shaped values in cap-01 only.

fields.name: sector0_payload_0x70c_pointers
fields.evidence: Small header word followed by six descending EWRAM pointers in cap-01 only.

fields.name: sector0_unclassified_0x730
fields.evidence: Byte patterns resemble ARM opcodes; no traced reader consumes file offsets 0x730-0x7f7. Not interpreted as gameplay fields.

fields.name: sector0_descriptor_table_0x87c
fields.evidence: Identical except first word in both files; pointer classes (IWRAM trampoline + ROM flash-driver area) match FUN_0806b8a4 descriptor copying, but the exact writer was not traced.

fields.name: sector1_block
fields.evidence: Reader/checksum chain fully traced; sample content is empty so field-level layout inside a non-empty block is unknown.

fields.name: sector2_block
fields.evidence: FUN_0804d938 loop index 1.

fields.name: sector3_block
fields.evidence: FUN_0804d938 loop index 2.

fields.name: sector4_block
fields.evidence: FUN_0804d938 loop index 3.

fields.name: unused_tail
fields.evidence: Uniform 0xFF in both 65536-byte files past 0x5000; no traced access to sectors >= 5.
